_comment: The settings tree: categories on the left, their pages, and what each page is made of.
A page is a list of blocks: "monitor" = everything on modules/settings/pages/MonitorPage.qml,
"bar/style" = only its group named "style" (PxGroup { name: "style" }). Every group is in
exactly one page (tests/settings checks it, and that no setting of the old tree got lost).
Blocks of one source file show in that file's order. Two levels only: category › page.
"legacy": the old page ids (links in the wizard, the tour, the helper, `angelos settings`)
and where they lead now; "to" may name a group, the page scrolls to it.
"developer"/"owner"/"game": shown only in developer mode / to the owner / while the game is on. "plugins": the category
where plugins' own settings pages are listed ("after": a plugin page that goes after a page).

"mac": the Golden Gate skin's own tree (services/GoldenGate.on): its look-and-feel pages (modules/settings/pages/MacPage.qml and the groups of the other files that fit a Mac) and the system pages without the pixel skins' groups. Its own "legacy" leads the old ids there; an id it doesn't know goes to "fallback". The pixel tree's pages are not shown while the skin is on.

2026-10-07 rebuild: Windows 11 sections, each with short pages. A page shows its "blocks" at once and folds its "more" under «Ещё…» (loaded when opened; the search opens it). "src/@" adds what sits outside src's groups (the Apply buttons, a log line). "ruHell"/"enHell": the name while the demon rules.
"preview": a live preview over the page (PxPreview): its scene (widgets/previews) and the setting whose value it plays.
